summary: Trident Digital Tech filed a Form 6-K to announce a planned ADS ratio change, converting the current ratio of 1 ADS per 8 Class B ordinary shares to 1 ADS per 240 Class B ordinary shares, effective April 24, 2026. This has the same effect as a 1-for-30 reverse ADS split; no fractional new ADSs will be issued, and cash will be paid for any fractional entitlements. The change does not affect the underlying ordinary shares or the trading symbol. It is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendation, or risk-arb angle apply.
